Superior Court Of New Jersey
Sheriff's Sale No. 26000925
Docket No. F-009642-25
Plaintiff – Rocket Mortgage LLC
Defendants- Cynthia Shepperson, Deceased, Her Heirs, Devisees and Personal Representatives, and Her Their, or Any of Their Successors in Right, Title and Interest; Nichele Renee Jackson, Individually and as Co-Adminstrator of The Estate of Cynthia R Shepperson; Mr. Jackson, Husband of Nichele Renee Jackson; Brian Shepperson, Individually and as Co-Adminstrator of The Estate of Cynthia R Shepperson; Mrs. Brian Shepperson, His wife; Atlantic County Board of Social Services; Laquanda Bond; Probation Services; State of New Jersey; United States of America
Writ of Execution
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public vendue on
Thursday September 24th 2026
between twelve noon and five o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 12:00 P.M. prevailing time at Atlantic County Courthouse Building in Mays Landing, New Jersey to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the Township of Hamilton, County of Atlantic and State of New Jersey:
Premises Commonly Known As:
4925 Cardigan Court Mays Landing, NJ 08330
Nearest Cross Street: Cardiff Ct
Dimensions: 20FT x 93FT
Tax Lot: 2002
Block No.: 1028.02
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Atlantic County Sheriff.
Priors/Lien(s)/Taxes: Pursuant to 28 USC 2410(c) this sale is subject to a 1 year right of redemption held by the United States of America by virtue of its lien:
Subordinate Mortgage: Cynthia Shepperson to Secretary of Housing and Urban Development, dated 08/22/2014 and recorded 10/16/2014 in VOL 13814 as Instrument Number 2014057296, to secure $55,706.00.
Partial Claim Mortgage: Cynthia Rose Shepperson to Secretary of Housing and Urban Development, dated 09-21-2020 and recorded 11/05/2020 in VOL 14885b as Instrument Number 2020056842, to secure $0.96.
Upset Amount: $161,587.67
Judgement Amount: $145,420.29
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Atlantic County Sheriff Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $148,839.61 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Joseph A. O'Donoghue, Sheriff
